title: Sale me 50% OFF... par kal bhi yahi daam?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Sale me 50% OFF... par kal bhi daam yahi tha!
Trick? Sale se pehle daam BADHAO...
pichhle tees din ka sabse kam daam dikhana padega!
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
Sale me badi si '50% OFF' dikhi... par yaad aaya, kal bhi to yahi daam tha! 🛒🤔

Ye khel aise hota hai:
• Discount hamesha ek 'pehle wale daam' (strike-through price) se nikala jaata hai.
• Agar sale se pehle wo daam badha diya jaaye, toh same price pe bhi discount bada dikhta hai. 2019 me data firm Semantics3 ne festive sale me kuch phones ke daam sale ke DAURAN pehle se ₹3,000 tak zyada list hote dekhe.

Ab naya rule: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Sept 2026 me notify hue, 1 January 2027 se lagu). Jab bhi platform discount dikhayega, use 'prior price' bhi dikhana hoga = pichhle 30 din me us product ka sabse kam daam. Matlab nakli 'pehle wala daam' ab nahi chalega.

Tip: abhi ke liye kharidne se pehle price-history check karo, sirf % OFF pe mat jao.

Tumne kabhi aisa nakli discount pakda hai? Comment karo 👇
